text:
marta: Kicking off postmortem follow-up thread for incident 2024-04-02. We need clear owners and a handoff plan to avoid ownership gaps. Proposal: weekly sherpa, 3-day overlap, and explicit backstop. Initial tickets: RW-3221, RW-3225, RW-3230. who can sherpa week 1?
devon: I can take week 1. I'll own RW-3221 (KV cache tuning) and RW-3230 (rate limiter thresholds).
leila: I'll be secondary on RW-3225 (alerting and dashboards). I'll write acceptance criteria and smoke tests.
nate: Can devon add rollback steps in the tickets too? We had some flaky rollbacks last time.
devon: yep adding rollback steps and ETA: Wed EOD. Adding AC: RW-3221 -> "95th latency improvement >=20% or revert flag deployed within 1 hour".
marta: I'll add RACI to the postmortem doc: R=Devon (sherpa), A=Marta (PM), C=EngSRE+Observability, I=Platform+Support. Backstop: Sam for week1.
sam: I can be backstop and take over if devon is on leave.
leila: I'm creating a parent epic so we can run SLA reports and velocity.
jira-bot: Created epic RW-3101: "Postmortem remediation sprint - sherpa week 1" and linked RW-3221, RW-3225, RW-3230.
oncall-bot: Reminder: PM action checklist due in 3 days for postmortem 2024-04-02.
marta: Devon please add a small verification checklist for post-deploy monitoring (dashboard queries + alert thresholds). Also tag any ticket with "repeat-pattern" if we see similar incidents within 30 days.
devon: added smoke test steps and repeat-pattern tag on RW-3221 (possible recurring KV TTL spike). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3221 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3225 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3230
leila: scheduled daily 15min stand for sherpa week and a weekly roundup with PM.
marta: perfect. please ensure sprint label "sherpa-week1" is set so ops dashboards pick these up. closing loop here, thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
